scenarios.theme: The API confirms an order, but a replica read says it does not exist. How will you fix the user contract?
scenarios.assumptions: Writes go to a primary and order-detail reads are round-robin among asynchronous replicas. Users immediately reload after checkout. What will you change without promising every follower is current?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

scenarios.theme: An acknowledged order disappears after failover. Which guarantee was missing?
